items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: as was John. ... We just hung out together.

ctx.x: Was he on the music scene or you just kind of knew him?
Well he was one of the so-called hipsters, the guys who appreciated the music, as was John. There was another brother whose name I can’t recall. We just hung out together.
You were describing the musicians. Were there some bands that you typically played in while you were there?
